_comment: Temperature Monitor Dashboard Configuration - Edit this file to customize your chart defaults

defaultTimeRange._comment: Default time range to show when page loads. Options: '5m', '1h', '3h', '6h', '12h', '24h'

refreshIntervals._comment: How often to refresh data (in milliseconds)

colors._comment: Chart line colors in hex format. Each sensor gets the next color, cycling back to start

sensorFilter._comment: Filter which sensors to display. Set enabled=true to filter, false to show all
sensorFilter._comment2: includePatterns: array of strings/regex patterns. Sensor name must match at least one pattern
sensorFilter._comment3: Example: ['Core'] shows only CPU cores, ['Package'] shows package temp, ['Core', 'Package'] shows both
sensorFilter._comment4: Patterns are case-sensitive partial matches - 'Core' matches 'coretemp/Core 0'
